provenance.source: packages/sim createWorld + step + applyEvent on worlds/runloop-commons (the engine the runtime hosts)
provenance.note: A new world starts Day 1 08:00. The runtime draws a random seed per world; re-export with the capture world's --seed so the 3-D residents match the captured screens.

clock.tick: one sim minute; tick 0 = Day 1 00:00; Day d HH:MM = (d-1)*1440 + HH*60 + MM
clock.productSpeeds: paused, 1x, 4x, 16x: at 1x one tick per wall second (WorldHost); real agents always run at real speed
clock.offline: the prototype does not simulate while Runloop is off: it resumes at the same tick and logs world.resumed_after_offline

segmentFormat.s: ['s', t0, action, placeId, gx, gy, inside, floor, pose, reason]
segmentFormat.w: ['w', t0=startTick, action, toPlaceId, fromX, fromY, rle, cells, reason]  position(t) = positionAt({path: decodeRoute({from, rle}), startTick: t0}, t, 1/3)
segmentFormat.lane: the Studio offsets walkers to the right of travel by laneOffset(idx) (town/place.ts) so two-way traffic passes

occupancy.rule: windows lit when occupancy > 0 (StaticTown.tsx), glowing x night factor

interactions.format: [tick, a idx, b idx, placeId, dAffinity]
